mapper.select: SELECT s.score_id, s.sid, s.course_id, s.usual, s.mid, s.final, s.total, s.gp, st.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, cl.name AS clazz_name FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid

SELECT s.score_id, s.sid, s.course_id, s.usual, s.mid, s.final, s.total, s.gp, st.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, cl.name AS clazz_name FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid WHERE s.sid = #{sid}

SELECT s.score_id, s.sid, s.course_id, s.usual, s.mid, s.final, s.total, s.gp, st.name AS student_name, c.name AS course_name, cl.name AS clazz_name FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.sid = st.sid LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN clazz cl ON st.cid = cl.cid WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (sid, course_id, usual, mid, final, total, gp) VALUES (#{sid}, #{courseId}, #{usual}, #{mid}, #{finalScore}, #{total}, #{gp})
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS name, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 1) AS value FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.course_id, c.name

SELECT CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score GROUP BY CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END
